name: 战刃挥刺
description: 选择正方向地格（6），冲刺至该格，可穿过敌人，对路径敌人造成1倍伤害。

(targetPos.x > caster.x ? 1 : -1) : 0; var dy = targetPos.y !== caster.y ? (targetPos.y > caster.y ? 1 : -1) : 0; var dist = Math.abs(targetPos.x - caster.x) + Math.abs(targetPos.y - caster.y); var trace = flow.query.tracePath(caster, {x:dx,y:dy}, {excludePieceId:caster.instanceId,maxDistance:dist,passEnemies:true}); var finalX = trace.lastLandableCell.x; var finalY = trace.lastLandableCell.y; var enemies = trace.encounters.filter(function(e){return e.type==='piece';}).map(function(e){return flow.query.piece(e.pieceId);}).filter(function(p){return p && !arePlayersAllied(battle,p.ownerPlayerId,caster.ownerPlayerId);}); if (finalX === caster.x && finalY === caster.y) { return { success: false, message: '路径被阻挡，无法冲刺' }; } if (!flow.effects.displace([{pieceId:caster.instanceId,x:finalX,y:finalY}], 'dash', {"passEnemies":true}).success) return {success:true,message:'位移被阻挡，本次位移效果取消'}; if (enemies.length > 0) { var result = dealDamage(caster, enemies, caster.attack, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '战刃挥刺，对' + enemies.map(function(e) { return e.name; }).join('、') + '造成' + result.totalDamage + '点伤害' }; } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '战刃挥刺冲向目标位置' }; }
